name: EPIC (Voter ID Card)
description: The primary identity document for voting. Issued by the Election Commission of India.
note: If lost, download e-EPIC from voters.eci.gov.in

name: Aadhaar Card
description: 12-digit unique identification number issued by UIDAI.
note: Digital Aadhaar on mobile is also accepted

name: Passport
description: Indian passport (valid or expired — both accepted).
note: Any Indian passport, regardless of expiry

name: Driving Licence
description: A valid driving licence issued by any Regional Transport Office in India.
note: Must have your photo on it

name: PAN Card
description: Permanent Account Number card issued by the Income Tax Department.

name: MNREGA Job Card
description: Job card issued under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act.

name: Health Insurance Smart Card
description: Smart card issued by the Ministry of Labour for health insurance.
note: Issued under the Labour Ministry scheme

name: Polling Slip
description: The slip delivered to your home before polling day with your booth details.
note: NOT a standalone ID — carry along with one photo ID
